svg.title: How a task flows through Panter-ai
svg.desc: Diagram in seven steps. 1: the leader delegates a task. 2: Panter stores it durably and attaches a GitHub permission scoped to that one task. 3: Panter wakes the worker through its route. 4: the worker claims the task with a fenced lease. 5: the worker does the work in its own app, on its own branch, and opens a pull request. 6: it completes with evidence; Panter stores the result, sends the leader a receipt and revokes the permission. 7: the leader reads the result and the pull request goes through the review and merge gate.
